answer: Forced Divergence Challenge: each agent must answer a fresh random challenge (e.g., sign a random nonce with a per-identity secret) within a short window; clones holding identical keys answer identically. The system requires each identity to whisper a distinct response, so a clone farm must maintain separate secrets per identity. Any duplicate response is a pearl of evidence that flags the whole cluster. Legitimate agents pay nothing extra; an attacker pays one secret-generation and storage cost per identity, and a single lotus of shared state collapses the farm.
